text_blocks.snippet: To test for COVID-19 antibodies, a blood test is required. This test, known as a serology test, detects the presence of antibodies, which are proteins produced by the body in response to a COVID-19 infection or vaccination. It does not detect the virus itself, nor does it indicate a current infection.

list.snippet: Request the test: You can either request the test from your doctor or through a service like Labcorp, which allows you to purchase the test online and have it reviewed by a healthcare professional.
Sample collection: A blood sample is typically drawn at a designated testing location.
